strongest_angle: Exploring the vast scale of the Milky Way galaxy by comparing the Earth's annual orbital motion around the Sun with the Sun's galactic journey at 828,000 km/h.

key_facts.fact: According to NASA data reported by Infinite Orbit, our solar system orbits the center of the Milky Way at a speed of 828,000 kilometers per hour.
The British Astronomical Association notes that the planet Earth possesses a physical diameter of 12,756 kilometers.
As calculated by the National Radio Astronomy Observatory, if the Earth were scaled down to a 0.004-inch grain of salt, the Milky Way galaxy's diameter would span approximately 5.1 million miles.
